doc: Declarative policy for scripts/check-r75.js (R75 / R100.A2). Banned literals live here as data, never assembled in executable source, so the checker cannot evade its own scan. .json is not in scan.includeExtensions, so this file is not self-matched.
patternNote: The three swallowed-error forms remain DISTINCT classes: deletion of one return form cannot pay for introduction of another. {{gap}} denotes whitespace or line/block comment trivia at a pattern boundary. Keyword boundaries prevent concatenated identifiers from matching. This is a lexical pattern gate, not a complete JavaScript/TypeScript AST analysis.

suppressions.note: R75 permits this directive when the same line carries a non-empty reason. Non-empty is the whole rule: no minimum length, no ASCII or alphanumeric requirement, no issue number. The exception applies to this directive occurrence only; other banned tokens on the same line still count.

scopeNote: Application AND test sources are in scope, including declarations, executable module variants and authored nested paths. Directory names alone prove no generated provenance. Positive roots exclude top-level dependencies/build output; no authored child or suffix is exempted. Source-root links fail closed. Fixture DATA remains outside executable extensions.
